THE CHALLENGE

GYM OPERATIONS ARE OFTEN SPREAD ACROSS TOO MANY TOOLS.

Many fitness businesses handle enquiries, memberships, payment follow-ups, attendance and trainer schedules through disconnected spreadsheets, messages and manual processes. This concept explores how these activities can be brought into one clear operational experience.

01

Fragmented Member Information

Membership details, attendance and communication may be stored in separate systems.

02

Manual Lead Follow-Up

New enquiries can be difficult to track when communication happens across forms, calls and messaging platforms.

03

Limited Operational Visibility

Owners need a simple way to understand memberships, attendance and upcoming renewals.

These are product-design assumptions used to frame the concept. They are not findings from a real client.

THE PRODUCT VISION

ONE CONNECTED WORKSPACE FOR MEMBERS, TRAINERS AND OPERATIONS.

The concept brings lead management, member management, attendance, trainer schedules and communication into a single, unified experience.
